content.text: {"comps":[{"label":"C1","good":false,"reason":"Makes lab instruments, reagents and diagnostic kits sold to labs; Doximity runs a physician network monetized by pharma marketing."},{"label":"C2","good":false,"reason":"Sells practice software and outsourced billing to providers; Doximity offers a free clinician network funded by pharma."},{"label":"C3","good":false,"reason":"Manufactures generic controlled-release drugs for pharma partners; no physician platform or pharma marketing business."},{"label":"C4","good":false,"reason":"Consumer prescription discount platform with memberships; Doximity serves clinicians and is funded by life sciences marketing."},{"label":"C5","good":false,"reason":"Operates clinical lab testing and contract research networks; Doximity is a digital clinician platform with marketing services."},{"label":"C6","good":false,"reason":"Sells patient experience and employee surveys to hospitals; no clinician network or pharma marketing business."},{"label":"C7","good":true,"reason":"Digital platform delivering pharma promotional messages to prescribers through EHRs, sold to drug makers, closely matching Doximity's pharma marketing model."},{"label":"C8","good":false,"reason":"Sells research instruments, test kits and lab software to labs; Doximity is a physician network with pharma marketing."},{"label":"C9","good":false,"reason":"Manufactures medical and dental products plus coding and documentation services; no clinician network or pharma marketing."},{"label":"C10","good":false,"reason":"Hospital EHR and revenue cycle software for rural hospitals; Doximity's clinician network and pharma marketing differ."},{"label":"C11","good":false,"reason":"Cloud CRM and data software sold to life sciences firms; Doximity offers a free physician network monetized through pharma marketing."}]}
